text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: high error-rate detected for tenant 'orpheus' on dedicated-pool-9 — metric: model.inference.5xx_rate > 15% over 5m. paging oncall @ana (sre-oncall) and eng-runtime.

ana (sre-oncall): I'm oncall and joining bridge now. grabbing recent logs and tailing the model runner. ETA 2m.

kevin (eng-runtime): I can see repeated GPU OOMs from the runtime logs around 1764506700. model key: redwood-4k-v1-quant. It spikes when sequence_len > 2048 and batching happens.

ana (sre-oncall): confirmed OOM pattern. process crashes then autoproc restarts -> causing 503s. customer traffic is pinned to this pool (dedicated-pool-9).

tess (customer-success): Orpheus reports ~20% of requests returning 503/timeout for the last 6m. They're on a critical ingest job. Rachael, heads-up to account team — they're watching.

rachael (account-exec): pinged Orpheus CSM and technical contact, scheduled a 1:1 bridge in 5. telling them we're actively mitigating. please prioritize a safe mitigation that doesn't require tenant migration if possible.

kevin (eng-runtime): Suggestion: enact tenant-level fallback policy to a safe variant that uses a lower-memory quantization or shorter context. I propose: pin model to redwood-4k-v1-safevariant (quant8-lite) or fallthrough to hosted-compatible redwood-2-mid for degraded throughput.

ops-bot: Executing policy check: found configured fallback policy for 'orpheus' -> fallback_candidates: ["redwood-4k-v1-safevariant","redwood-2-mid-hosted"], automatic_fallback: manual_approval_required = true.

ana (sre-oncall): manual_approval_required — I approve automatic pin to safevariant to stop the 503s. doing step by step: 1) pin tenant model to redwood-4k-v1-safevariant 2) reduce batch size to 1 for that tenant 3) enable KV prefix caching bypass to lower memory pressure 4) monitor 1m.

kevin (eng-runtime): Applying pin now. patching route table for tenant 'orpheus':
```yaml
tenant_id: orpheus
action: pin_model
model: redwood-4k-v1-safevariant
batch_size: 1
route: dedicated-pool-9
reason: runtime OOM -> immediate mitigation
```

ops-bot: Pin operation started (op_id=op-20260315-001). Will report status in this thread.

ana (sre-oncall): lowered per-tenant batch_size and applied pin. monitoring logs. initial health: 503 rate dropping.

kevin (eng-runtime): Observing decreased memory pressure and fewer restarts. 5xx rate moved from 18% -> 4% in last 90s. CPU/GPU utilization also stabilized. :thumbsup:

tess (customer-success): Orpheus confirmed lower errors on their side. They're still seeing some timeouts but far better. Asking for ETA on full recovery and whether this will impact latency/cost.

ana (sre-oncall): short answer: recovery is in-progress. safevariant increases latency ~8-12% per call and reduces throughput (we reduced batch_size). cost delta negligible compared to failed requests. will follow up with perf numbers in 30m.

rachael (account-exec): I'll let their director know status: mitigation in place, degraded perf but service restored, team working on permanent fix.

kevin (eng-runtime): Next steps for root cause: reproduce OOM with internal repro that simulates Orpheus request shapes (long sequences + large batch). hypothesis: quantized model path has an allocation regression with large KV cache entries. I'll open an infra bug and include logs.

ana (sre-oncall): Incident timeline so far:
- 1764506721 alert firing: sustained 5xxs
- 1764506730 oncall paged
- 1764506745 confirmed OOMs
- 1764506760 manual approval for fallback given
- 1764506792 pin to safevariant applied
- 1764506860 5xxs dropped below 5%

ops-bot: op_id=op-20260315-001 status=SUCCESS. pinned model for tenant orpheus to redwood-4k-v1-safevariant.

tess (customer-success): Orpheus wants to know if we can make this fallback automatic for similar bursts. what's the policy threshold?

kevin (eng-runtime): current tenant policy allows automatic fallback but some customers (for cost/perf reasons) have manual_approval_required. We can propose a tiered policy: auto-fallback when >20% 5xx over 2m OR >2 restarts in 5m. We'll draft a recommended policy and send to CSM/Account for approval.

ana (sre-oncall): Action items:
- kevin: open runtime bug + repro + assign (JIRA-6121).
- eng-runtime: evaluate safevariant memory regression and PR a fix (priority P1).
- ops: consider offering Orpheus a temporary allowlist to enable automatic fallback for this event class.
- tess/rachael: follow up with customer communications and postmortem invite.

rachael (account-exec): capturing agreement from Orpheus to trial auto-fallback for 48h. they accepted. I'll document in the customer ticket.

ana (sre-oncall): closing immediate mitigation. We'll keep monitoring for 1h and update on final RCA. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident update logged (incident-1764506789). Corresponding postmortem request queued.

kevin (eng-runtime): FYI I'm starting a canary to test a targeted kernel fix on a staging replica. will report results here.

ops-bot: Monitoring endpoints show stable behavior for dedicated-pool-9 and fallback remains active for tenant orpheus.

tess (customer-success): Orpheus confirmed behavior looks good after fallback. They'll expect a post-incident summary and mitigation timeline.

ana (sre-oncall): will publish summary + timeline and link RCA when ready. marking this thread resolved for paging but keeping it open for notes until postmortem completed.
